Question 6
?

Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function f(x,y,z)=arcsin⁡zx+y?

a
A family of surfaces given by z=arcsin⁡(c(x+y))
b
A family of surfaces given by z=sin⁡(c(x+y))
c
A family of surfaces given by z=csin⁡(x+y)
d
A family of surfaces given by z=cos⁡(c(x+y))
e
A family of planes: z=cx+cy
